Profil de ressource: FR PractitionerRole Document

URL officielle: https://interop.esante.gouv.fr/ig/fhir/document-core/StructureDefinition/fr-practitionerRole-document Version: 0.1.0
Draft à partir de 2026-07-03 Nom computable: FRPractitionerRoleDocument

Ce profil représente les professionnels de santé et leurs rôles dans le cadre d'un document médical.

Utilisations:

  • Utilise ce/t/te Profil: FR Bundle Document
  • Référence ce Profil: FR Actor Extension, FR Composition Document, Condition - FR Condition Document, DeviceRequest - FR Device request Document... Show 27 more, DeviceUseStatement - FR Device Use Statement Document, DiagnosticReport - FR Diagnostic Report Document, FR Encounter Care Document, FamilyMemberHistory - FR Family Member History Document, Immunization - FR Immunization Document, Media - FR Media Document, MedicationRequest - FR Medication Request Document, Observation - FR Observation Administration Blood Derivatives Document, Observation - FR Blood Product Transfusion Document, Observation - FR Observation Contra Indications Document, Observation - FR Observation Laboratory Report Results Document, Observation - FR Observation Medical Summary Document, Observation - FR Observation Microorganism Detection Document, Observation - FR Observation Multiresistant Microorganisms Identification Document, Observation - FR Observation Pregnancy Document, Observation - FR Observation Radiation Exposure Document, Observation - FR Observation Result Document, Observation - FR Observation Survey Document, Observation - FR Observation Transfusion Accidents Document, Observation - FR Observation Vital Signs Document, Observation - FR Observation Vital Signs Panel Document, Observation - FR Observation Work Related Accident Document, FR Performer Event Extension, Procedure - FR Procedure Document, Procedure - FR Procedure Imaging Document, Specimen - FR Specimen Document and Task - FR Task Patient Transport Document

Vous pouvez également vérifier les usages dans le FHIR IG Statistics
